# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b10 — Device-first configuration

**Opt-in beta 10 for Home Assistant 2026.10+.** Stable **v0.5.1** remains unchanged and earlier prerelease tags remain immutable. The existing `air_quality_advisor` integration domain, saved entries and native physical device controls retain their identities. Back up your Home Assistant configuration before upgrading.

## Configure only sources and equipment

The setup and Configure menus concentrate on choosing **rooms, data providers, weather sources, measurement sensors and managed equipment**. Hardware identity, actuator permissions, physical commissioning, safety intervals and interlocks stay in those setup screens, where cross-field checks are necessary. Adjustable everyday policy values no longer clutter source selection.

## Home and Area device controls

The Home device exposes global environment thresholds, announcements and language, home occupancy policy, AQI source scales and thresholds and pollen preferences. Each Area device retains its compact environment overview and exposes only settings calculated or managed by the integration, not copies of your actual climate, fan, or humidity controller controls.

Room-native Time entities edit **sleep start and end**. Other area settings include occupied, unoccupied, away, and sleep comfort bands, humidity policies, scientific PMV inputs, CO₂/exposure preferences, and relevant operating strategies. Where equipment has actually been commissioned, direct PWM/proportional tuning and bounded rate limits become editable from the Area device. Existing supervisor PID gain source and manual Kp/Ki/Kd controls are preserved; these conservative fixed defaults are **not automatic PID tuning**.

## Mold indication: explicit cold-surface measurement

When mold indication is enabled, select a valid same-area indoor temperature sensor and weather temperature source in Configure. Enter a **physically measured temperature of the room's coldest surface** in its Area Number entity and press **Recalculate mold factor**. The calculation checks source ownership, fresh observations and physically plausible temperature geometry. A new surface measurement invalidates any older factor. A failed recalculation does not silently overwrite an otherwise valid calibration; status, provenance and timestamps are exposed as attributes.

## Localization, testing and actuator safety

All **38 supported Home Assistant locales** have regenerated labels, selector explanations and native device controls. Greek, German, English, Spanish and French terminology is tailored; other supported locales use deterministic localized vocabulary while technical Home Assistant identifiers retain their literal spelling. Regression tests guard against English text returning to localized mold calibration fields.

Publishing is gated on Python **3.13 and 3.14** test suites, reproducible translation generation, frontend card validation, Hassfest and HACS, plus manual ZIP package checks. The release supplies its manual installation ZIP and SHA-256 checksum. Software testing **does not certify HVAC electrical, compressor, defrost, thermal or fan protections**. New settings grant no actuator authorization; unverified experimental power switching and automatic compressor-mode changes must remain disabled.

Install through HACS using **Redownload → Show beta versions → v0.6.0b10**, then restart Home Assistant. Keep the existing configuration entry. If HACS cannot select prereleases, use the manual installation ZIP instead of downloading the stable channel.
